title: Love Avengers released a new single titled " this is me " featuring Mayalove Coppola
htmlContent:
Uk-based artist and songwriter "Love Avengers" is an energetic artist and has released a new single, "This is me".this is an empowerment anthem that is all about you. Yes, it is all about loving yourself and being 100% unapologetically you.

This song empowers you to be comfortable in your skin."This is me" is a happy, euphoric and ecstatic song that gets you dancing. the captivating and free-spirited vocals and beats get you excited, inspire you to be the best version of yourself, and make you feel good about being you. It inspires self-love and positivity. "This is me" is an anthem you will be singing, and it will be stuck in your heart that whenever you look in the mirror, you can't help but scream this is me.

Love avengers did it again with this Retro soul uplifting music. The beats and the vocals, together with a beautiful rendition, bring a sounding harmony.  "this is me" will bring a specific energy that radiates whenever it is played.

After hearing about this song, we had to bring her to our page.

Listen to this "This is me" song on Spotify. 

Follow Love avenger on Instagram
